voice.name: Nugget + Sprocket
voice.model: Nugget's lines: the eleven_v3 reads in short05_vo_nugget_01/02_SPROCKET_VOICE (mislabelled: they are in Sprocket's voice) converted to Nugget's voice with eleven_multilingual_sts_v2, timing kept (short05_vo_nugget_lines_sts.mp3); Sprocket's 'Wrench, please' from short05_vo_sprocket_01, his 'Close' from Veo's own take re-voiced; all placed on the mouths

signoff.note: audio/signoffs/signoff_nugget.mp3 at 1.15x, on Nugget's beak ~0.35-2.1s into the tail

video.description: SPROCKET (refs/characters/sprocket_noprop_ref.png) beside the workbench, NUGGET hero form (refs/characters/nugget_hero_ref.png) standing on it; the wrench and the carrot lie on the bench from the first frame. One continuous two-shot, both speaking on camera.

shots.note: Nugget's beak moves 0.3-1.1 ('I'm Nugget!'); in the clip Sprocket's mouth moves 1.5-2.9 under Nugget's line, so 1.1-3.7 is replaced by the insert

4s insert from the main clip's frames at 1.1s (start) and 3.7s (end, Sprocket's mouth closed): Nugget 'I help with EVERYTHING!' 0.1-1.6, Sprocket steps forward ~0.9-1.5, holds out his hoof and says 'Wrench, please' 3.3-3.6. Veo reaches the end frame at 3.67s (matches the main clip at 3.72s, PSNR 32.8), so it is cut there, so the cut back is a hard cut (the earlier insert ended on a mouth-open frame and needed a dissolve that ghosted)

main clip from 3.7: Nugget grabs the carrot and says 'Wrench!' 3.8-4.5, Sprocket looks down at it ~4.7, 'Close' 6.0-6.8; cut at 7.5 (both eyes open). The first attempt (Veo gave Sprocket's line to Nugget) is in archive/shorts/short05/v2_lines_swapped/

veo-3.1-generate-001 (standard) from the main clip at 7.5s: Nugget cheers 'We can fix anything!' with wings up, beak moving ~0.5-1.5, Sprocket's mouth closed 0.4-2.1; cut at 2.15, before Sprocket starts mouthing and reaches for his pouch. The fast model gave the line to Sprocket's mouth three times (v6-v9, archived)
